gloss: weak tea from used leaves; spent tea leaves

definitions.gloss: weak tea from used leaves; spent tea leaves
definitions.explanation: Tea, or tea leaves, that have already been steeped several times and have lost their flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出|で}がらし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧だ。
examples.english: This tea is made from used leaves.

examples.japanese: {出|で}がらしな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧しか⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The leaves are used up, so the tea only comes out weak.

examples.japanese: {出|で}がらし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{茶葉|ちゃば}→茶葉：15508_chaba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{捨|す}て→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Spent tea leaves are sometimes used for cleaning instead of being thrown away.

notes:
From ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (of tea, to brew out) + {涸|か}らす (to drain dry). Used figuratively, and unkindly, for a person or idea whose freshness is used up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出|で}がらし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧: weak tea from used leaves
- {出|で}がらし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{茶葉|ちゃば}→茶葉：15508_chaba⟧: spent tea leaves

CULTURAL NOTE:
Serving a guest {出|で}がらし is a small discourtesy; a good host puts in fresh leaves.
